messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Hydrochlorothiazide is also an ingredient in many combination blood pressure medicines.
These medicines include combinations with losartan, lisinopril, valsartan, and more.
Triplet: ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "is ingredient in", "combination blood pressure medicines"]

The relation 'is ingredient in' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject entity is a component or active ingredient present in the medication or product specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'contains ingredient': The subject drug product contains the active ingredient specified by the object entity.
B. 'manufactured by': The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.
C. 'related to': The subject drug is associated with the medical condition or disease specified by the object entity.
D. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
E. 'belongs to drug class': The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological or therapeutic drug class specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
